spans.s:
मौल^1 a. (ला, --ली f.) [मूलं वेत्ति
मूलादागतो वा अण्]
1 Radical,
original.
--2 Ancient, old, of long
standing (as a custom).
--3 Nobly born,
of a good family.
--4 Brought up in
the service of a king for
generations, holding office from ancient
[]
times, hereditary;

57.
--लः An old or hereditary
minister; (प्रकृतयः)
मौलैरानाययामासुर्भरतं स्तंभिताश्रभिः

; 18. 38.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170209. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/336. note: missing vowel diacritic.

मौलि a. [मूलस्यादूरभवः इञ्] Head,
foremost, best; अखिलपरिमलानां
मौलिना सौरभेण

.
--लिः
1
The head, the crown of the head;
मौलौ वा रचयांजलिं

.
--3 The Aśoka tree.
--लिः
(m. f.)
1 A crown, diadem, tiara;

.
--2 Hair on the crown of
the head, tuft or lock of hair;
जटामौलि

;
--लिः, --ली
f. The earth.
--Comp.
--मणिः, --रत्नं a
crest-jewel, a jewel worn in the
crown.
--मंडनं a head-ornament.
--मुकुटं a crown. tiara.

मौलिक a. (की f.)
1 Radical.
--2
Chief, principal, prime;
संजीवनोपायस्तु मौलिक एव रामभद्रस्याद्य संनिहितः

.
--3 Inferior.
--कः A dealer in or
digger of roots.
मौलिन् a. Having a crown, crested.
